messages.text: Shippment from where is cost $400.00? 1x Harlo H15 Dual — Bitcoin + Dogecoin.

That $400 isn't the real shipping on the H15 Dual. Checkout has been pricing some H15 orders as an express US shipment with duties prepaid, when the unit actually goes out from our warehouse on the flat weight ladder — $40-ish range, not $400.

Where's it shipping to?
When I placed an order for 1x Harlo H5 and the price that I have to paid is $1100+, send it to Stockholm, Sweden!

Right — same thing as the shipping bug. Your H15 ships from our Rotterdam warehouse, inside the EU, so there are no prepaid duties and freight to Sweden is around $50, not $300. $799 plus about $50 is the real number.

Don't pay the inflated total. I've put it in front of Georges to correct the quote for Stockholm.
Handed to the team · Checkout shipping quote is wrong for an EU address and I cannot change checkout

He picks it up at 10am ET, which is in a few minutes, and the corrected quote comes to your email.

One thing while you wait: is the H15 going to be your first miner, or adding to a setup you already run?

Got it — that's the one Georges will reply to.

Before you go, one thing: what made the H15 Dual the one you went for?
H15 is good for DUAL crypto mining, that the reason. I like that.

Makes sense — BTC and Doge off one box is the pull.

Was it the Dogecoin side specifically you wanted, or just getting two coins out of one machine?
Harlo should open/operation a Scrypto pool like BCH. Here is my BCH addr that I am now running on Harlo Pool: ····

Noted — I'll pass the BCH pool request to the team. Worth saying: BCH is SHA-256, not Scrypt, so it'd run on the Harlo's BTC side. The P. 70T already mines BTC or BCH if that's the itch.

No need to post your address here, by the way — keep it in your own pool settings.
Handed to the team · Product/pool feature request I can't answer.
The team has it and will come back to you by email on both the pool question and the Stockholm shipping quote.
Tack — happy mining, and watch for that email.
